plotEn:
Gay party promoter Peter Green lives a hedonistic, drug-fueled lifestyle at various clubs around New York City. At one party, he meets British tourists Leonora and Edison. While Peter is having sex with a man, Leonora joins them, leading to a threesome. 
Ten years later, Peter is in his thirties and still partying, to the chagrin of his business partner Sophie. When Peter arrives to a business meeting high, Sophie fires him and takes control of his promoting. Edison unexpectedly arrives at Peter's apartment with ten-year-old Arlo, whom she reveals is Peter's son, resulting from his tryst with Leonora. She further explains that Leonora was married to a man named Felix at the time of Arlo's conception, and initially led Felix to believe Arlo was his, though Felix became physically abusive toward both of them when DNA testing revealed this to be false. Leonora has recently committed suicide, and Peter is Arlo's only living relative. Edison leaves Arlo in Peter's care while she ostensibly runs errands, promising to retrieve Arlo in no more than two hours. Peter reluctantly spends the day with Arlo and allows him to sleep in his apartment overnight when Edison fails to collect him as promised; the following morning, Peter discovers that Edison has returned to London, leaving Arlo in his care indefinitely.
